description: Source code for telemetry report generation, including JSON encoding, string trimming, and HTTP URL preparation functions.

methods.name: checkForEmptyString
methods.description: Checks if a string is empty, null, or explicitly 'NULL' or whitespace.

methods.name: freeProfileValues
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for profileValues structure.

methods.name: convertVectorToJson
methods.description: Converts a Vector of strings to a cJSON array.

methods.name: destroyJSONReport
methods.description: Deletes a cJSON object representing a JSON report.

methods.name: trimLeadingAndTrailingws
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: encodeParamResultInJSON
methods.description: Encodes parameter name and value lists into a JSON array.

methods.name: encodeStaticParamsInJSON
methods.description: Encodes static parameters into a JSON array.

methods.name: encodeGrepResultInJSON
methods.description: Encodes grep results into a JSON array.

methods.name: encodeEventMarkersInJSON
methods.description: Encodes event marker data into a JSON array.

methods.name: prepareJSONReport
methods.description: Prepares a JSON report string from a cJSON object.

methods.name: prepareHttpUrl
methods.description: Constructs a complete HTTP URL with query parameters, escaping values as needed.
